subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should maintainers keep this combined issue open, or split it across the reply-metadata implementation path and the durable final-fallback contract?
rationale: Current main partially covers UI quoting and hidden text-context transport, but the remaining work spans Control UI/Gateway protocol shape, agent runtime metadata, and channel final-delivery semantics.

options.title: Split Across Existing Owners
options.body: Use the reply-metadata PR or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in the durable final-fallback issue, and close this issue only after both halves are represented.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface umbrella until one maintainer-approved design covers both reply metadata and no-output UX together.

options.title: Defer Structured Reply Metadata
options.body: Treat Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI for now and keep only the final-fallback delivery contract active.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Owners
recommendation.body: Use the reply-metadata PR or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in the durable final-fallback issue, and close this issue only after both halves are represented.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main routing signal is recent work across the Control UI send path, Gateway chat schema, and runtime-context helper boundary.
